chapters.name: ch1_open
chapters.title: Natural Perfume Oil
chapters.caption: Attar is a natural perfume oil, made the old way: no alcohol, no shortcuts.

chapters.name: ch2_ingredients
chapters.title: Raw Botanicals
chapters.caption: Hand-picked Damask rose petals harvested at dawn, paired with aged Assam oud wood and rare Mysore sandalwood.

chapters.name: ch3_distillation
chapters.title: Hydro-Distillation
chapters.caption: Botanicals and pure mountain water simmer inside sealed copper degs. Fragrant steam rises through bamboo chonga pipes.

chapters.name: ch4_condensation
chapters.title: Cold Condensation
chapters.caption: Steam cools in underwater copper receivers, separating into floral water and pure aromatic oil, collected drop by drop.

chapters.name: ch5_vial_fills
chapters.title: Maturation & Pouring
chapters.caption: Aged for twelve months in camel-skin vessels so volatile top notes harmonize into deep, enduring base accords.

chapters.name: ch6_macro_texture
chapters.title: Undiluted Pure Oil
chapters.caption: 100% pure essence without synthetic fixatives. A single dab warms to your skin chemistry and radiates for 24+ hours.

chapters.name: ch7_incense_smoke
chapters.title: The Ritual
chapters.caption: Applied to pulse points and warmed with slow friction—a mindful sensory tradition passed down through generations.

chapters.name: ch8_closing_hero
chapters.title: Oudh & Rose
chapters.caption: From petal to still to vial — nothing added, nothing rushed.
